audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Shen the First item and 2+ item rows while whys[5] and whys[6] say the opposite in the same matchup, and Level 2 read 'Skill' where the mirror puts the flip.
audit.why: Shen's lane power is Shadow Dash (18s at rank 1) plus Spirit's Refuge (16s at rank 1) — real from 2 to 5. After items, Silver Bolts' true damage ignores every resistance he buys, and his taunt is 600 units with no follow-up damage, so the item rows are Vayne's. 54.55% over 1164 games agrees.
audit.corrected: Vayne, Shen, Shen, Shen, Vayne, Vayne, Vayne — proposed as matched full/content pairs with matching ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5] described the first item as a fight-forcing spike without saying what it does to Shen specifically, and level 6 never mentioned Stand United's 200s cooldown.
audit.why: Blade of the Ruined King plus Silver Bolts is percent-max-health true damage — the one damage type Shen's stacked armour and MR do nothing about. Stand United is 200/180/160s and global, so at 6 the value is in the wave he abandons.
audit.corrected: The item spike is true damage that ignores his stacking; his 6 is a map tool, not a duel tool.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nowhere states that Stand United is a channel Condemn cancels, and Spirit's Refuge was only ever called 'his W block'.
audit.why: The kit flags Stand United as channel — interruptible, and Condemn is hard CC at 550 range, so a Condemn inside that range cancels the teleport and burns his 200s. Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks that would hit Shen or allies near the spirit blade, which is exactly what stops Silver Bolts stacking.
audit.corrected: Condemn cancels Stand United outright; do not stack bolts into Spirit's Refuge.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is 18/16/14/12/10s and is his only way to reach Vayne.
audit.corrected: Commit once Shadow Dash is spent — 18s at rank 1, 10s at rank 5.
